schemes.title: Sikkim Aama Sashaktikaran Yojana (Aama Yojana)
schemes.department: Women, Child, Senior Citizen and Divyangjan Welfare Department, Government of Sikkim
schemes.brief: Mothers in Sikkim who have no job get Rs.40,000 a year, paid in two instalments of Rs.20,000 straight into their own bank account through the State Bank of Sikkim. It started in 2021-22 as the Aama Yojana at Rs.20,000 a year. It was later renamed and the amount doubled. Married, unmarried, widowed, divorced and separated mothers can all get it. You collect the form at your Block Development Office, the Gram Sabha or Ward Sabha passes your name, and officials check it before the money is released.
schemes.benefit: Rs.40,000 a year, paid in two instalments of Rs.20,000
eligibility: A mother aged 18 to 59 with no regular job or income. This includes married, unmarried, widowed, divorced and separated mothers, and mothers of a legally adopted child
Holds a Sikkim Subject Certificate, a Certificate of Identification (COI) or a Residential Certificate
Her name is on the voter list for a ward of her Gram Panchayat or urban local body
The family holds a Priority Household (PHH) or Antyodaya (AAY) ration card
Not eligible if she gets any government pension, if anyone in the household has a regular government, PSU or bank job, or if she or her husband is an enlisted government contractor or supplier
documents: Attested copy of the Sikkim Subject Certificate, COI or Residential Certificate
Voter card (EPIC), with an attested copy
PHH or AAY ration card
Birth certificate of the child
Aadhaar card of the mother
Front page of the bank passbook (savings account in the mother's own name)
Gram Sabha or Ward Sabha resolution recommending her name
Three passport-size photographs
schemes.portalName: Women, Child, Senior Citizen and Divyangjan Welfare Department, Sikkim
schemes.submitAt: Get the form from the Block Development Office (BDO) at your Block Administrative Centre and hand it back there with all the photocopies, three photographs and the Gram Sabha or Ward Sabha resolution. Take the originals of your certificate of identity, voter card and ration card to show. Ask for a receipt.

demoFields.label: Name of mother (as per Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Write the name exactly as it is on your Aadhaar card. The beneficiary list is made from it.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's name
demoFields.hint: Your husband's name, or your father's name if you are unmarried, widowed or separated.

demoFields.label: Constituency, GPU / Ward
demoFields.hint: Your Assembly constituency and the Gram Panchayat Unit or municipal ward where you vote.

demoFields.label: SSC / COI / Residential Certificate number
demoFields.hint: Copy the number from your certificate and attach an attested copy.

demoFields.label: Voter card (EPIC) number
demoFields.hint: Your own voter card. It must be registered in the same ward.

demoFields.label: Ration card number and category
demoFields.hint: Only PHH or AAY cards qualify. Write the category printed on the card.

demoFields.label: Name and date of birth of child
demoFields.hint: Your child's name as on the birth certificate you attach.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The mother's own 12-digit Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: A savings account in your own name. The money comes here by direct transfer.

demoFields.label: Are you employed or getting any pension?
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. A job or pension in your household makes you ineligible, and wrong answers lead to recovery.

demoSteps: Collect the Aama Sashaktikaran form at your Block Development Office and fill in your details.
Ask your Panchayat or ward councillor to get your name passed in the Gram Sabha or Ward Sabha, and take the resolution copy.
Submit the form with all photocopies, three photographs and the resolution at the BDO office, and keep the receipt.
The Social Welfare Inspector checks your papers, then the BDO and the district officers verify and the District Collector approves.
Your name appears on the beneficiary list. The Rs.20,000 instalments are paid twice a year into your bank account, often handed over at a constituency cheque camp.
If you move out of Sikkim permanently, the payment stops and you must surrender the scheme passbook.
schemes.helpline: 181 — Women Helpline, Sikkim; your Block Development Office (Block Administrative Centre)

schemes.title: Mukhya Mantri Jeevan Raksha Kosh and SSIAF (Referral Treatment Help)
schemes.department: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Sikkim
schemes.brief: If the State Medical Board refers a Sikkimese patient for treatment that Sikkim cannot give, the state pays up to Rs.2 lakh. You get cashless treatment at listed hospitals in Delhi, Kolkata, Siliguri, Vellore, Mumbai and inside Sikkim, or a reimbursement. BPL patients first get Rs.1.5 lakh under the Sikkim State Illness Assistance Fund (SSIAF), then another Rs.1.5 lakh from this fund, Rs.3 lakh in all. Regular government servants and their dependants are not covered. Since a 2022 amendment the rules are also called the Mukhya Mantri Swasthya Suvidha Yojana (MMSSY).
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs.2 lakh for referred treatment; up to Rs.3 lakh for BPL patients
eligibility: Holder of a Sikkim Subject Certificate or Certificate of Identification (COI), or a family on the state BPL list
Referred by the State Medical Board for treatment outside Sikkim or at an empanelled hospital
Regular government servants and their dependants are not covered
Patients under 20 qualify through their birth certificate and the father's SSC or COI. A woman married to an SSC or COI holder needs her own COI and a marriage certificate
BPL patients use the SSIAF limit of Rs.1.5 lakh first, then up to Rs.1.5 lakh more from MMJRK
documents: Referral certificate from the State Medical Board, STNM Hospital
Attested copy of the patient's Sikkim Subject Certificate or COI
BPL list proof (for SSIAF)
For a patient under 20: birth certificate and father's SSC or COI
For a married woman: her COI and marriage certificate
Doctor's estimate or hospital bills for the treatment
Aadhaar card and bank passbook of the patient or attendant
schemes.submitAt: First get the referral from the State Medical Board at STNM Hospital, Sochakgang, Gangtok. Then take the referral certificate, the attested SSC or COI copy (and BPL proof) to the Health & Family Welfare Department. The department approves the amount before you travel. Cashless treatment is only at empanelled hospitals. Elsewhere you claim a reimbursement with the bills. In a life-threatening emergency you can be treated first and claim within six months.

demoFields.label: Name of patient
demoFields.hint: As written on the patient's SSC or COI.

demoFields.label: Age and gender
demoFields.hint: Patients under 20 must add a birth certificate and the father's SSC or COI.

demoFields.label: SSC / COI number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the certificate and attach an attested copy.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: APL or BPL. BPL patients get the SSIAF amount first, then MMJRK on top.

demoFields.label: Illness and treatment advised
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the State Medical Board referral.

demoFields.label: Referral certificate number and date
demoFields.hint: From the referral given by the State Medical Board at STNM Hospital.

demoFields.label: Hospital referred to
demoFields.hint: Choose an empanelled hospital to get cashless treatment.

demoFields.label: Attendant's name and relation
demoFields.hint: The family member who will travel with the patient.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number the department can call about the approval.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC (for reimbursement)
demoFields.hint: Needed only if you pay first and claim the money back.

demoSteps: Your doctor in Sikkim sends your case to the State Medical Board at STNM Hospital, which gives a referral certificate.
Take the referral and your attested SSC or COI (and BPL proof if you have one) to the Health & Family Welfare Department.
The department checks your papers and approves the amount for your illness, up to Rs.2 lakh, or Rs.3 lakh for BPL patients.
Go to the empanelled hospital. Treatment there is cashless up to the approved amount. Anything above it the family pays.
If you were treated in an emergency or at a non-cashless hospital, submit the bills within six months for a reimbursement into your bank account.
For a follow-up visit, ask the department whether a balance is left from your first approval.
schemes.helpline: 03592-202633 — Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Sikkim

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Konya Bibaha Yojana (MKBY, Girls' Marriage Help)
schemes.department: Social Welfare & Social Education Department, Government of Tripura
schemes.brief: Tripura gives Rs.50,000 once for the marriage of a girl from an Antyodaya (poorest) family, when the bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21. Up to two girls in one family can get it. You apply at the CDPO office, which checks the papers and sends them to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate within 15 days. The SDM pays once the marriage is confirmed and registered. The scheme was notified in August 2025 and covers about 2,000 girls a year.
schemes.benefit: Rs.50,000 once, for each eligible girl (up to two girls per family)
eligibility: The bride must be 18 or older and the groom 21 or older on the date of marriage
The bride's family must be in the state's Antyodaya database (Antyodaya ration card)
The bride must be a permanent resident of Tripura (PRTC holder)
Neither bride nor groom may have a living spouse, unless the earlier marriage was legally dissolved by divorce
Help is given once per girl, for at most two girls in a family
The marriage is registered at the venue or right after it
documents: Aadhaar card and PRTC of the bride
Age proof of the bride (birth certificate or school leaving certificate)
Antyodaya ration card of the bride's family
Aadhaar card and address proof of the groom
Age proof of the groom
Passport-size photographs of bride and groom
Self-declaration on marital status, signed by both bride and groom (form attached)
Bride's bank account details
schemes.portalName: Directorate of Social Welfare & Social Education, Tripura
schemes.submitAt: The Child Development Project Office (CDPO) of the ICDS project where the bride lives. Hand in the filled form with photocopies of every document and the self-declaration signed by both bride and groom, and keep the originals to show. The CDPO forwards it to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) within 15 days. If you are refused, appeal to the District Magistrate & Collector, who must decide within 10 days.

demoFields.label: Name of the bride (in BLOCK letters)
demoFields.hint: Capital letters, exactly as on her Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's / Guardian's name
demoFields.hint: The parent or guardian named on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Permanent address (as per Antyodaya ration card)
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the Antyodaya card. It is used as address proof.

demoFields.label: Antyodaya ration card number
demoFields.hint: Attach a photocopy. Only Antyodaya cards qualify.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of bride, with bank details
demoFields.hint: The money is paid into the bride's own account, so give her account number and IFSC.

demoFields.label: PRTC number
demoFields.hint: The bride's Permanent Resident of Tripura Certificate. Attach a copy.

demoFields.label: Age and date of birth of bride
demoFields.hint: She must be 18 or more on the wedding day. Attach the birth or school leaving certificate.

demoFields.label: Name of the groom
demoFields.hint: As written on the groom's Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Age and date of birth of groom
demoFields.hint: He must be 21 or more on the wedding day.

demoFields.label: Date and venue of marriage (if already held)
demoFields.hint: Fill this only if the wedding has already taken place. The SDM confirms the marriage before paying.

demoSteps: Download the form or ask for it at your CDPO office, and get both bride and groom to sign the self-declaration.
Submit the form with all the photocopies at the CDPO office of the bride's area and take an acknowledgement.
The CDPO checks eligibility and sends the application to the SDM within 15 days.
The marriage is registered, either at a mass marriage event held by the SDM or on its own, and the SDM confirms it.
After confirmation, Rs.50,000 is sanctioned and paid into the bride's bank account.
If the application is rejected, appeal to the District Magistrate & Collector.
schemes.helpline: 0381-2326033 — Directorate of Social Welfare & Social Education, Agartala; your CDPO or SDM office

schemes.title: Monthly Financial Assistance to Women Heads of BPL Families (Rs.2,500)
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Puducherry
schemes.brief: Puducherry pays Rs.2,500 a month to the woman who heads a BPL (red) ration card family, aged 21 to 55. It was Rs.1,000 until a January 2026 notification raised it. There is no separate application now. The department picks eligible women every month from the Civil Supplies ration-card data, checks them against other schemes, and pays straight into the woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account. Being shown as head on a BPL card, with Aadhaar seeded, is what gets you in.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,500 a month, paid into the woman's own bank account
eligibility: Head of a BPL family ration card (AAY or PHH), aged 21 to 55
Living in the Union territory of Puducherry continuously for the past 5 years. A woman from another state qualifies 5 years after her name is added to a Puducherry BPL card
Only one woman per card is paid: the eldest woman aged between 21 and 55
Must not get any other monthly financial help funded by the Centre or the UT, such as an old age or widow pension
Must not live in a home or institution that gives free boarding and lodging
documents: BPL family ration card showing her as head of the family
Aadhaar card, seeded with the ration card
Bank passbook of an account in her own name, linked to Aadhaar
Age proof (birth certificate, school or college transfer certificate, or marriage registration certificate)
Mobile number
Signed undertaking that she gets no other government financial assistance
schemes.portalName: Department of Women and Child Development, Puducherry
schemes.submitAt: There is no application form now. The department reads the details from the Civil Supplies ration-card data. First make sure your BPL card shows you as head of the family, with Aadhaar linked, at the Civil Supplies office. If you are eligible but not being paid, go with your ration card, Aadhaar and bank passbook and sign the undertaking. In Puducherry region go to the Deputy Director (Social Defence), Old Age Pension Section, Department of Women and Child Development. In Karaikal go to the Child Development Project Officer. In Mahe or Yanam go to the Welfare Officer.

demoFields.label: Name of the applicant
demoFields.hint: There is no form to fill now. These are the details the department reads from your ration card, so check that they are correct on the card.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's name
demoFields.hint: As printed on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.hint: The address on your ration card.

demoFields.label: Family ration card number
demoFields.hint: Your BPL card number. You must be shown as head of the family.

demoFields.label: Type of card (AAY / PHH)
demoFields.hint: Only AAY and PHH (BPL) cards qualify. APL cards do not.

demoFields.label: Date of birth / age
demoFields.hint: Between 21 and 55. If two women on the card qualify, the elder one is paid.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: It must be seeded with the ration card and linked to your bank account.

demoFields.label: Getting any other government financial help?
demoFields.hint: Anyone already getting a pension or similar monthly help is not eligible. You sign an undertaking saying this.

demoFields.label: Living in Puducherry for the past 5 years?
demoFields.hint: Continuous residence of 5 years is required.

demoFields.label: Bank name and account number
demoFields.hint: The money is sent to the Aadhaar-linked account in your own name.

demoSteps: Check your ration card at the Civil Supplies office: it must be a BPL (AAY or PHH) card with you as head of the family and your Aadhaar seeded.
Link your Aadhaar to a bank account in your own name.
Every month Civil Supplies uploads card data to the Unified Data Hub, and the department prepares the list of eligible women after removing those in other schemes.
The list is put up on the website for social audit. Sign the undertaking at the department office if you are asked to.
Rs.2,500 is paid into your Aadhaar-linked account after the end of each month.

If the money does not come, go to the Deputy Director (Social Defence), the CDPO Karaikal or the Welfare Officer of Mahe or Yanam. You can appeal to the Secretary, Women and Child Development, within 30 days of a decision.
schemes.helpline: 0413-2244785 — Department of Women and Child Development, Puducherry

schemes.title: Chandigarh Old Age Pension
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Chandigarh Administration
schemes.brief: A monthly pension for Chandigarh residents aged 60 and above whose family income is up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year. The UT pays Rs.1,000 a month, and with the central share the pensioner gets Rs.1,200, or Rs.1,500 from age 80. You apply at any Sampark centre, where the operator scans your documents and files the application online. The pension is paid every month into your Aadhaar-seeded bank account. About 18,600 people get it.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,200 a month (Rs.1,500 from age 80), including the central share
eligibility: Age 60 years or above
Total family income not above Rs.1.5 lakh a year
Living in Chandigarh for more than 3 years
Not already getting another pension (the form asks for the amount and source if you do)
documents: Two passport-size photographs, one cross-signed on the form
Aadhaar card
Residence proof for the last three years (voter card, ration card, electricity bill, house allotment letter or residence certificate)
Date of birth proof (birth certificate, school leaving certificate, passport, PAN card or senior citizen card)
Income certificate from the competent authority
Mobile number and bank account details for the Aadhaar-seeded pension account
schemes.portalName: Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Chandigarh
schemes.submitAt: Any Sampark centre in Chandigarh. Take the filled form with the cross-signed photograph, the signed self-undertaking and the Aadhaar consent page, plus the originals of your Aadhaar, three-year residence proof, age proof and income certificate. The operator checks and scans them and files the online application on the e-District system. If you have no birth proof, get your age certified first by the Principal Medical Officer at GMSH-16 or GMCH-32. For questions, go to the Department of Social Welfare, Additional Town Hall Building, 3rd Floor, Sector 17-C.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Name
demoFields.hint: The person in whose name the pension order will be issued.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar or voter card.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: Must be 60 or more. Attach the date of birth proof.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar No.
demoFields.hint: The pension is linked to this Aadhaar and paid to the account seeded with it.

demoFields.label: Mobile No.
demoFields.hint: SMS updates on your application come here.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Tick Male, Female or Transgender.

demoFields.label: Belong to SC / OBC
demoFields.hint: Tick only if it applies to you.

demoFields.label: House No. / Sector or Village
demoFields.hint: Where you have lived for the last three years. It must match your residence proof.

demoFields.label: Present total family monthly income
demoFields.hint: Add up everyone's income. A year's total must not be above Rs.1.5 lakh.

demoFields.label: Whether in receipt of any pension
demoFields.hint: If Yes, write the monthly amount and who pays it.

demoSteps: Download the old age pension form, or take one at the Sampark centre, and fill in your details.
Paste the photograph, cross-sign it, and sign the self-undertaking and the Aadhaar consent page.
Go to a Sampark centre with the originals. The operator scans them, files your application online and gives you the application number.
The Social Welfare Department verifies the papers and sanctions the pension. Track it on the e-District status page with your application number.
The pension is paid every month into your Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Give your life certificate to the department each year so the pension does not stop.
schemes.helpline: 0172-2700372 — Department of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Chandigarh; 181 — Women and Child Helpline

schemes.title: Andaman & Nicobar Old Age Pension (Social Security Pension)
schemes.department: Directorate of Social Welfare, Andaman & Nicobar Administration
schemes.brief: Old people in the islands get Rs.2,500 a month from 60, and Rs.3,000 a month from 80, paid into their bank account. It is for people who have lived in the islands for at least 10 years and whose household earns less than Rs.48,000 a year. One common form covers the old age, widow, destitute and disability pensions. You hand it in at the CDPO office of your area. More than 15,600 people get this pension.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,500 a month (Rs.3,000 a month from age 80)
eligibility: Age 60 years or above
Living in the islands continuously for at least 10 years (local certificate or resident identity card)
Household income less than Rs.48,000 a year (Rs.4,000 a month)
Not getting any other pension, allowance or grant from the government
From age 80 the pension rises to Rs.3,000 a month
documents: Local certificate or domicile certificate
Aadhaar card
Bank account number (passbook copy)
Income and residence certificate from the Tehsildar (printed on the form)
Age certificate from a Medical Officer (printed on the form)
Certificate from your Pradhan or Councillor (printed on the form)
Signed declaration that you get no other government assistance
schemes.portalName: Directorate of Social Welfare, A&N Administration
schemes.submitAt: The office of the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) of your area: Urban (Sri Vijaya Puram), Ferrargunj, Rangat, Diglipur or Car Nicobar. Forms are also free at the Directorate of Social Welfare, Goalghar, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair). Before you submit, get the Tehsildar's income and residence certificate, the Medical Officer's age certificate and the Pradhan's or Councillor's certificate filled in on the form. Attach the local certificate and an Aadhaar copy.

demoFields.label: Name of assistance applied for
demoFields.hint: Tick Old Age Pension. The same form is used for widow, destitute and disability pensions.

demoFields.label: Name of the applicant
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' if he has died.

demoFields.label: Sex
demoFields.hint: Male or Female.

demoFields.label: Married / Unmarried / Widow
demoFields.hint: Your present status.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must show you are 60 or more. The Medical Officer certifies your age on the form.

demoFields.label: Present address
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, with village or ward.

demoFields.label: Category (APL / BPL)
demoFields.hint: As on your ration card.

demoFields.label: Details of assistance received from Govt./local bodies
demoFields.hint: Write Nil if you get no pension or grant. Anyone already getting one is not eligible.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The pension is paid into this account every month.

demoSteps: Download the pension form or collect it free at the CDPO office or the Directorate of Social Welfare.
Get the Tehsildar's income and residence certificate, the Medical Officer's age certificate and the Pradhan's or Councillor's certificate on the form.
Sign the declaration and hand in the form with your local certificate and Aadhaar copy at your CDPO office.
The CDPO checks that you get no other assistance and sends the case to the Directorate of Social Welfare for sanction.
Once sanctioned, Rs.2,500 (Rs.3,000 from age 80) is paid into your bank account every month.
Give a life certificate every year in the prescribed format to your Anganwadi worker or Mukhya Sevika, or the pension is suspended.
schemes.helpline: 03192-233356 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair); your CDPO office

schemes.title: Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen) — DNH and Daman & Diu
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu (through District Panchayats and Municipal Councils)
schemes.state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
schemes.brief: Senior citizens of Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu get Rs.1,500 a month from age 60 and Rs.2,000 a month from age 70, by direct transfer to the bank. It is for domiciles of the UT with a family income up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year. You hand in the form at your Gram Panchayat, District Panchayat or Municipal Council. The application should be decided within 30 days, and the pension arrives by the 5th of every month.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 a month at 60-69; Rs.2,000 a month at 70 and above
eligibility: Domicile of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
Age 60 years or above
Annual family income not above Rs.1.5 lakh
Not getting money under any other old age pension scheme
The form asks whether you have applied for a Portuguese or other foreign passport. Answer truthfully
documents: Age certificate (proof that you are 60 or above)
Income certificate showing family income below Rs.1.5 lakh
Domicile certificate
Aadhaar card
Copy of the bank passbook (account linked to Aadhaar)
Passport-size photograph
Signed undertaking (printed with the form)
schemes.submitAt: Address the form to the Chief Executive Officer of the District Panchayat (villages) or the Chief Officer of the Municipal Council (towns). Hand it in at your Gram Panchayat, or at the District Panchayat or Municipal Council office in Silvassa, Daman or Diu, with all the documents. In villages the Gram Sevak recommends it, it is read in the Gram Sabha, and the Sarpanch and Panchayat Secretary approve it before it goes up.

demoFields.label: Pension scheme
demoFields.hint: Tick Old Age. The same form is used for widow and Divyang pensions.

demoFields.label: Name
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Father / Husband name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' if he has died.

demoFields.label: Address and mobile number
demoFields.hint: Your full address and a working mobile number.

demoFields.label: Name of Panchayat
demoFields.hint: Your Gram Panchayat, or write the Municipal Council if you live in a town.

demoFields.label: Age, date of birth and gender
demoFields.hint: At 70 or above you get Rs.2,000 a month.

demoFields.label: Applicant family annual income
demoFields.hint: Must not be above Rs.1.5 lakh. Attach the income certificate.

demoFields.label: Receiving financial assistance from any other agency?
demoFields.hint: Anyone already getting another old age pension is not eligible.

demoFields.label: Name of bank, account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The account must be linked to Aadhaar. The pension is credited here.

demoFields.label: Applied for Portugal or any other passport?
demoFields.hint: Answer Yes or No truthfully. This question is on the official form.

demoSteps: Download the form, or collect it at the District Panchayat or Municipal Council office, and fill in Part 1.
Attach the age, income and domicile certificates, Aadhaar and the bank passbook copy, and sign the undertaking.
Submit it at your Gram Panchayat, District Panchayat or Municipal Council office and keep the receipt.
Field staff verify your papers. In villages the application is read in the Gram Sabha, and the CEO or Chief Officer approves it, usually within 30 days.
The pension is credited to your bank account by the 5th of every month.
Give a life certificate to the field staff every year to keep the pension running.
schemes.helpline: 0260-2632303 — District Panchayat, Dadra & Nagar Haveli (Silvassa); the District Panchayat or Municipal Council office at Daman or Diu

schemes.title: UT of Lakshadweep State Pension Scheme (Old Age Pension)
schemes.department: Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Lakshadweep (through the District Panchayat and Village (Dweep) Panchayats)
schemes.brief: Lakshadweep pays Rs.1,500 a month to permanent residents above 60 who have no income of their own. The same state pension also covers widows, abandoned people and persons with disabilities. You apply at your island's Village (Dweep) Panchayat office. The application is checked there and again at the District Panchayat, Kavaratti, and the money is paid every month into your Aadhaar-linked bank account. About 3,500 islanders get it.
eligibility: Permanent resident of the Union territory of Lakshadweep
Above 60 years of age (the same scheme also covers widows, abandoned persons and persons with disabilities)
No source of income; monthly income not above Rs.1,500
Not getting any other similar government pension
People with no financial support from their family are given priority
documents: Aadhaar card
Age proof (birth certificate or other record showing date of birth)
Residence certificate showing you are a permanent resident
Income certificate
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-linked account in your own name
Passport-size photograph
schemes.portalName: Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Lakshadweep
schemes.submitAt: The office of the Executive Officer of the Village (Dweep) Panchayat on your island. The form is given there free. Hand it back with photocopies of your documents and show the originals. After the VDP Evaluation Committee checks it, the VDP sends it to the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat (HQ), Kavaratti.

demoFields.label: Name of applicant
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar card. The form is collected at your VDP office; these are the details it asks for.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' if he has died.

demoFields.label: Island and Village (Dweep) Panchayat
demoFields.hint: The island where you live and its Village Panchayat.

demoFields.label: Date of birth / age
demoFields.hint: You must be above 60. Attach age proof.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The pension goes to the bank account linked to this Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Monthly income
demoFields.hint: Write your own monthly income. Above Rs.1,500 makes you ineligible.

demoFields.label: Family support
demoFields.hint: People with no support from family are given priority.

demoFields.label: Getting any other pension?
demoFields.hint: Anyone already getting a similar government pension is not eligible.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An Aadhaar-linked account in your own name.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number the VDP office can call.

demoSteps: Collect the pension form from the Executive Officer at your Village (Dweep) Panchayat office.
Fill it in, attach your documents and hand it back at the VDP office.
The VDP Evaluation Committee checks your application and forwards it to the CEO, District Panchayat, Kavaratti.
District Panchayat officials check it again and add your name to the pensioners' list sent to the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department.
Rs.1,500 is paid every month into your Aadhaar-linked bank account.
If nothing comes, ask the VDP Executive Officer or call the department at Kavaratti.
schemes.helpline: 04896-262314 — Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Kavaratti; the Executive Officer of your Village (Dweep) Panchayat
